item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Uses window counting and DISTINCT to retain one row per hour, including the NULL hour group.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Counts each distinct pickup timestamp first, then combines counts by hour with an explicit BIGINT result.","sql":"WITH timestamp_counts AS (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(n) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM timestamp_counts GROUP BY 1"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Applies the original calendar-day predicate, then uses window counting and DISTINCT to preserve route counts and NULL route keys.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Aggregates routes by day of month before filtering and combining counts, preserving the original date predicate and BIGINT count type.","sql":"WITH route_day_counts AS (SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT pickup, dropoff, CAST(SUM(n) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM route_day_counts WHERE pickup_day <= 7 GROUP BY 1, 2"}]}
